questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that the road may be slippery when wet. You should slow down and be careful in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that traffic is coming from the opposite direction on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves. Slow down and be prepared to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow and black warning sign. It tells drivers that a lane is ending. Be ready to safely merge with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers which direction they must travel on a one-way street. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. All traffic in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right. Slow down and be prepared to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that a school zone is coming. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When an operator extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they are turning left or changing lanes to the left. You can use hand signals instead of or along with your turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until it is safe to proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road will join from the right at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming. Be ready for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to protect your brakes and prevent accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drive carefully in areas where pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged with red on top and green on the bottom when vertical, or red on the left and green on the right when horizontal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. Watch for trains when you see this sign.
